images.title: The toggles of locker 12 are its factors
images.purpose: Shows that locker 12 is toggled by the people 1, 2, 3, 4, 6 and 12, its factors, which join in three partner pairs.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. One locker number at the top and one row of factor tokens below it, joined by three nested arcs.
images.exact_structure: At the top centre: one tall closed locker door outlined dark with a plate reading 12. Below it, one horizontal row of exactly 6 equal round tokens, evenly spaced, reading from left to right 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 12, each with a white fill and a dark outline. Exactly 3 nested arcs drawn above the row join the partner tokens: the outer arc joins 1 and 12 in teal (#0072B2), the middle arc joins 2 and 6 in amber (#E69F00), the inner arc joins 3 and 4 in reddish purple (#CC79A7). Below the row, centred: 6 toggles. Nothing else in the frame.

images.takeaway: A locker is toggled once for each factor of its number, and factors come in partner pairs.
images.description: Shows that locker 12 is toggled by the people 1, 2, 3, 4, 6 and 12, its factors, which join in three partner pairs.
images.context: 12 = 1 × 12 = 2 × 6 = 3 × 4, six factors, so locker 12 ends closed.

image_decisions.why: Joining the toggling people in partner pairs shows at a glance that toggles are factors and that they pair up.
